title: Apologize

cues.en: I'm holding on your rope

cues.text: I'm holding on your rope

cues.en: And I'm hearing what you say

cues.en: But I just can't make a sound

cues.en: You tell me that you need me
cues.zh: 你告訴我你需要我

cues.en: Then you go and cut me down, but wait
cues.zh: 然後你去把我砍下來，但等一下

cues.en: You tell me that you're sorry
cues.zh: 你告訴我你很抱歉

cues.en: Didn't think I'd turn around and say
cues.zh: 沒想到我會轉過身來說

cues.en: That it's too late to apologize, it's too late
cues.zh: 道歉為時已晚，為時已晚

cues.en: I said it's too late to apologize, it's too late
cues.zh: 我說道歉太遲了，太遲了
cues.text: I said it's too late to apologize, it's too late

cues.en: Too late, oh
cues.zh: 太遲了，哦
cues.text: Too late, oh

cues.en: I'd take another chance, take a fall
cues.zh: 我會再嘗試一次，摔一跤
cues.text: I'd take another chance, take a fall

cues.en: Take a shot for you
cues.zh: 為你拍攝
cues.text: Take a shot for you

cues.en: And I need you like a heart needs a beat
cues.zh: 我需要你像一顆心臟需要一個節拍
cues.text: And I need you like a heart needs a beat

cues.en: But it's nothing new, yeah yeah
cues.zh: 但這不是什麼新鮮事，是啊是啊
cues.text: But it's nothing new, yeah yeah

cues.en: I loved you with a fire red, now it's turning blue
cues.zh: 我用火紅色愛你，現在它變成藍色
cues.text: I loved you with a fire red, now it's turning blue

cues.en: And you say
cues.zh: 然後你說
cues.text: And you say

cues.en: Sorry like the angel, heaven let me think was you
cues.zh: 像天使一樣抱歉，天堂讓我以為是你
cues.text: Sorry like the angel, heaven let me think was you

cues.en: But I'm afraid
cues.zh: 但我害怕
cues.text: But I'm afraid

cues.zh: 道歉太晚了，太晚了
cues.text: It's too late to apologize, it's too late
